mapper.select: SELECT ti.TEST_TYPE_CODE AS deptCode, IFNULL(c.TYPE_NAME, ti.TEST_TYPE_CODE) AS deptName, IFNULL(SUM(q.ISSUE_DT >= ), 0) AS curCnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(q.ISSUE_DT >= , ti.NET_SALES, 0)) / 10000, 0), 0) AS curNetMan, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(q.ISSUE_DT >= , ti.CHRGS, 0)) / 10000, 0), 0) AS curChrgsMan, IFNULL(SUM(q.ISSUE_DT < ), 0) AS prevCnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(q.ISSUE_DT < , ti.NET_SALES, 0)) / 10000, 0), 0) AS prevNetMan FROM TEST_ITEM_TB ti INNER JOIN QUO_TB q ON q.QUO_YM = ti.QUO_YM AND q.QUO_SEQ = ti.QUO_SEQ AND q.STATE <> 'D' LEFT JOIN COMCODE_TB c ON c.TOP_CD = 'TT' AND c.TYPE_CD = ti.TEST_TYPE_CODE WHERE ti.STATE <> 'D' AND ( q.ISSUE_DT BETWEEN AND CURDATE() OR q.ISSUE_DT BETWEEN AND ) GROUP BY ti.TEST_TYPE_CODE, deptName

SELECT x.deptCode AS deptCode, IFNULL(SUM(x.cur), 0) AS curDoneCnt, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(IF(x.cur, x.days, NULL)), 1), 0) AS curLeadDays, IFNULL(SUM(x.cur AND x.days >= 60), 0) AS curOver60Cnt, IFNULL(SUM(x.prev), 0) AS prevDoneCnt, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(IF(x.prev, x.days, NULL)), 1), 0) AS prevLeadDays FROM ( SELECT t.TEST_TYPE_CODE AS deptCode, DATEDIFF(t.TEST_STATE_DT, t.INS_DT) AS days, (t.TEST_STATE_DT >= ) AS cur, (t.TEST_STATE_DT < ) AS prev FROM TEST_TB t WHERE t.STATE <> 'D' AND t.TEST_STATE_CODE = 18 AND t.INS_DT IS NOT NULL AND t.TEST_STATE_DT IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(t.TEST_STATE_DT, t.INS_DT) >= 0 AND ( t.TEST_STATE_DT BETWEEN AND CURDATE() OR t.TEST_STATE_DT BETWEEN AND ) ) x GROUP BY x.deptCode

SELECT t.TEST_TYPE_CODE AS deptCode, COUNT(*) AS wipCnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(ti.NET_SALES) / 10000, 0), 0) AS wipMan, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), t.INS_DT)), 0), 0) AS wipAvgAge, IFNULL(SUM(t.TEST_STATE_CODE IN (3, 4, 5)), 0) AS stuckCnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(t.TEST_STATE_CODE IN (3, 4, 5), ti.NET_SALES, 0)) / 10000, 0), 0) AS stuckMan, IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), t.INS_DT) >= 90), 0) AS aged90Cnt FROM TEST_TB t INNER JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB ti ON ti.TEST_ITEM_SEQ = t.TEST_ITEM_SEQ AND ti.STATE <> 'D' WHERE t.STATE <> 'D' AND t.TEST_STATE_CODE NOT IN (18, 19, 20) GROUP BY t.TEST_TYPE_CODE
